simpleenchanting.guide.page.1.title: Simple Enchanting
simpleenchanting.guide.page.1: Two enchanters above Vanilla's table: the Dark Enchanter, where you pick three enchantments with sliders, and the Astral Enchanter on a Nihil Obsidian floor, which lifts Protection and Feather Falling to V.
simpleenchanting.guide.page.2.title: Dark and Astral Enchanter
simpleenchanting.guide.page.2: Pick your enchantments yourself: three random ones that fit the item, each with a slider up to its maximum, paid from a level budget the shelves and the floor set.
simpleenchanting.guide.page.3.title: Dark and Astral Enchanter
simpleenchanting.guide.page.3: Dark up to 50, Astral up to 60 with Protection V and Feather Falling V.
simpleenchanting.guide.page.4.title: Floors and shelves
simpleenchanting.guide.page.4: SimpleBuilding owns the building blocks the tables need: Blazing and Nihil Obsidian, blazewood planks and bookshelves. Installed alone, this module brings its own of them.
simpleenchanting.guide.page.5.title: Creative tabs
simpleenchanting.guide.page.5: The module's items sit in its own creative tab only (no Vanilla tabs).

simpleenchanting.guide.page.7.title: Settings
simpleenchanting.guide.page.7: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
